recommendation: Keep the commit. It preserves later udiCarrier decisions while removing the remaining misleading binary wording identified by FHIR-5849.
issue_request: FHIR-5849 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for DSTU1 Device. It objected that the UDI guidance forced UDIs into a binary instance-or-type interpretation and asked to restore a dedicated UDI representation with clear examples.
initial_application: Commit 85cad2a017a228c70b358dab887c56b5bfccb18e pre-applied FHIR-5849 with related 2015 Device UDI comments, removing direct guidance to put full UDIs in Device.identifier or Device.type and pointing the full UDI string at Device.udi. That application retained a shortened instance-or-type sentence in the Device notes.
additional_context: Later Device UDI work replaced the DSTU1 Device.udi string with the current Device.udiCarrier backbone, examples, mapping guidance, and search parameters. FHIR-8926, FHIR-29312, FHIR-43063, FHIR-47419, and FHIR-48769 show later final decisions that refined the current udiCarrier and production-identifier model rather than reverting to the old string element.
reconciliation: Updated the active Device.udiCarrier ElementDefinition comment and the Device UDI notes to say that a UDI can identify a unique instance, identify only the type, or carry production information such as lot number or expiration date without uniquely identifying an individual instance.
source_changes: source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml: clarified the Device.udiCarrier comment to include non-serial production-information cases.
source/device/device-notes.xml: clarified the UDI notes to include non-serial production-information cases.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue established that UDI is not simply a Device.identifier because it can act as an instance identifier or a kind code.
DSTU1 Device ballot comment tied to FHIR-5849 that moved the full UDI string out of Device.type guidance and into the dedicated UDI element.
DSTU1 Device ballot comment that generalized UDI repository wording and was applied with the same Device notes changes.
DSTU1 Device ballot comment whose proposed identifier/type split was reconsidered through FHIR-5849.
Later Published issue rewrote Device notes around UDI DI/PI components and examples, forming the basis of the current notes.
Later Published issue clarified Device and DeviceDefinition identifier relationships without reverting to full UDI-as-identifier/type.
Later Applied issue added Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifierSystem, confirming udiCarrier as the current representation.
Later Applied issue clarified Device.udiCarrier wording and its relationship to DeviceDefinition UDI identifiers.
Later Applied issue clarified Device production-identifier element descriptions.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification OO issue objecting that Device UDI guidance treated UDI as only a unique instance identifier or only a device type.
evidence_items.learned: The final Jira decision requires the current Device source to avoid the instance/type binary and represent UDI separately and clearly.

evidence_items.summary: The active resources section includes device=Device.
evidence_items.learned: The edited Device StructureDefinition and notes files are current core build inputs.

evidence_items.summary: Current Device source has the udiCarrier backbone plus UDI notes and examples/mapping links, but the edited comment and note still framed UDI as instance-or-type before this commit.
evidence_items.learned: The needed source change is a wording correction in active UDI guidance, not restoration of the obsolete Device.udi string.

evidence_items.summary: The initial pre-application for FHIR-5849 and related Device UDI comments moved full UDI guidance to Device.udi but retained shortened instance-or-type wording in Device notes.
evidence_items.learned: Historical application handled most of the issue but left wording that could still mislead implementers about UDIs with non-serial production identifiers.

evidence_items.summary: Later Published UDI guidance rewrote Device notes to incorporate DI/PI component guidance and examples.
evidence_items.learned: Later history supports preserving component-based udiCarrier guidance rather than restoring the old DSTU1 Device.udi string shape.

evidence_items.summary: Later final Device UDI and identifier issues clarified identifier relationships, udiCarrier system fields, wording, and production identifier descriptions.
evidence_items.learned: These later decisions confirm that current reconciliation should keep Device.udiCarrier and only correct the lingering binary wording.

evidence_items.summary: A 2022 thread described UDI as a global concept involving item identifier plus lot, serial, expiry, barcode, and human-readable form.
evidence_items.learned: Community discussion supports the corrected wording that UDI can carry production information without uniquely identifying one instance.
